title: Split Firestore migration with freeze and media manifest

deliverables.requirement: Split collection model with deterministic ids and schema metadata.
deliverables.evidence: index.html defines SPLIT_SCHEMA_VERSION/SPLIT_MIGRATION_POLICY_VERSION, _splitDocId(), _splitMeta(), buildSplitMigrationPlan(), and produces students/logs/payments/consults/inquiries/scheduleOverrides/attendanceProposals/auditEvents/media docs with schemaVersion, policyVersion, revision, deletedAt, updatedBy, migratedFrom, legacyHash, and migrationRunId.

deliverables.requirement: Migration path with maintenance/freeze or live-hash checkpoint and drift abort.
deliverables.evidence: beginSplitMigrationFreeze() records current legacy hash; writeSplitMigrationPlan() requires active freeze unless explicitly overridden and aborts when current legacy hash differs from plan. Browser check verified freeze, drift abort, and admin-auth gate.

deliverables.requirement: Dry-run reports, idempotent writes, and dual-read verification.
deliverables.evidence: buildSplitMigrationPlan() returns counts/checksums/warnings/errors/verifications; writeSplitMigrationPlan() uses deterministic document ids and set(...,{merge:true}); verifySplitMigrationPlan() compares split counts with legacy arrays. Browser check verified deterministic ids/checksums and count verification.

deliverables.requirement: Media manifest and placeholder quarantine so [saved] is never success.
deliverables.evidence: _splitCollectMedia() creates media manifest docs with status/recoveryRequired/quarantineReason; _splitCloneNoMedia() strips [saved] to empty/[recoveryRequired]. Browser check verified 3 placeholder media entries became recoveryRequired and split docs did not preserve [saved] as migrated media success.
firestore.rules now allows admin-only /studios/{studioId}/{document=**} in addition to legacy /studio/{docId}.

checks.name: inline script parse
checks.command: node extraction/new Function over every inline script in index.html
checks.result: 7 scripts parsed successfully; main script 8145 lines.

checks.result: No whitespace errors; command emitted only a line-ending warning for firestore.rules.

knownConstraints: Live split writes were not executed because Firebase admin authentication is unavailable in this environment; writeSplitMigrationPlan() correctly returned admin-auth-required under freeze.
G002 remains blocked on Firebase CLI authentication for rules deployment/live unauthorized-denial verification.
